verified: 620: Sassanid Persia correctly holds Levant/Egypt/Cilicia (Khusrau II's conquests of 613-621); Byzantium retains Cyrenaica, Tripolitania and Africa/Ifriqiya (exarchate falls only in 698).
650: Rashidun regions (Syria 636, Egypt 641, Cyrenaica/Tripolitania raided by 643-648) match the early conquests; Byzantine Africa (TUN) correctly untouched.

680-711: Khazar acquisition of Crimea (CRM) between the 680 and 711 slices matches the historical Khazar tudun installed at Cherson (Justinian II's exile there, c. 695-705); Byzantium regains CRM by 870, consistent with 9th-century Theme of Cherson reassertion.

711: Umayyad conquest of Iberia limited to CAS_S/AND with Visigothic rump surviving elsewhere is a defensible mid-conquest snapshot (Guadalete July 711, Toledo falls same year but full conquest runs to 716) and is already flagged in the file's own uncertainties.
750: Abbasid capital given as Kufa checks out - al-Saffah was proclaimed caliph at Kufa in 750 and used it as administrative seat until building al-Hashimiyya (752) and then Baghdad (762).
824: Emirate of Crete founding date and Chandax as capital match modern scholarly consensus (Byzantine sources' 824 date preferred over Arabic sources' 827/828).

843-870: East Francia holding the Pannonian plain (HUN) reflects the real Carolingian March of Pannonia (Frankish suzerainty via the Slavic dukes Pribina/Kocelj) prior to the Magyar conquest of 895-900.

All entity founding years cross-checked (franks 481, visigoths 418, byzantium 395, sassanid 224, avars 567, lombards 568, umayyad 661, abbasid 750, al_andalus 756, asturias 718, khazars 650, bulgaria 681, navarre 824, moravia 833, kievan_rus 862/882, bohemia 895, croatia 845, serbia 780, georgian_states 813) match the data-spec's canonical registry exactly.

Crete, Cyprus condominium, Aghlabid, Tulunid, Rustamid/Idrisid/Barghawata Maghreb splits, and the 900 Magyar/Pecheneg steppe handover all match mainstream accounts and are internally consistent across adjacent slices.

uncertainties: No high/medium-confidence territorial errors found after checking every slice's frontier regions (Crimea, Cyprus, Balearics, North Africa, Pannonia, the Caucasus, the Pontic steppe) against the year-by-year narrative and against founding dates in the data spec's canonical registry.

One low-confidence soft spot noted but not corrected: Rashidun Caliphate's 650 slice includes ARM/GEO as (contested) territory, while the Caucasus campaigns of Habib ibn Maslama are more often dated 653-654; the file already marks both regions contestedRegions, which is an adequate hedge for a coarse-grained slice year and not worth overriding.

The file's own uncertainties list (11 items) already transparently documents every genuine region-resolution approximation (NAP/Naples-Byzantine overlap, BOH Bohemia/Moravia fusion, SUI Alemannia/Burgundy overlap, Balearics timing, Sicily contested dates, Croatia/Burgundy founding-year choices); none of these needed further correction.
